primary_sources.scope: MPS dtype-converting CPU copies can overwrite source storage; reproduced here in direct copy tests.
MPS nonzero-offset fused copy/cast wrong output; reproduced here.
The unified-memory allocator can reserve a 1 GiB heap for a 10 MiB parameter.
Advanced indexing requires int64 and binds the index resource as read-only; no int32 cast is visible in this path.
The gather shader reads constant int64 indices.
Packed attention projection weights create nonzero-offset K/V slices. This is a next diagnostic candidate, not a proven cause.
The MPS no-graph linear path supplies the parameter storage offset explicitly.
